title: Finite constructible derived reductions of a completed etale integral line
statement: Let ell be a prime, E a finite extension of Q_ell, and X any scheme. Let H be a sheaf of O_E-modules on the small etale site of X which becomes the constant regular module on a specified etale covering. Let M be its pro-etale comparison inverse image, encoded over the constant integral ring sheaf and extended along the canonical map to the completed coefficient sheaf. For every n >= 0, the derived scalar reduction of M[0] to the quotient O_E/(pi_E^(n+1)) is intrinsically finite-torsion constructible and its cohomological support is contained in [0,0], uniformly in n. This statement does not assert derived completeness.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2(1), Proposition 6.8.4(1), Corollary 5.1.5, Sections 3.5 and 6.5; specialization to an etale-trivial integral line

proof.text: Comparison and associated-module sheafification transport the etale trivializations to constant-ring module trivializations. Ordinary completed scalar extension then gives the completed regular module on the same charts. Tensor with this line is locally the identity, so it is exact and the degree-zero line is K-flat.

Use the K-flat degree-zero representative for derived scalar reduction. Associativity of scalar extension and the completion projections identify the reduction with the pro-etale realization of H tensor O_E/(pi_E^(n+1)). The identification respects descent because the tensor maps and quotient projections commute with every overlap restriction.

The valuation ring has finite positive quotients. Therefore each finite-level etale line has finite regular-module local models. Comparison transports them to finite pro-etale local models. The single stratum X is locally closed and constructible in itself, so this is a constructible finite-coefficient module sheaf.

The degree-zero single complex has that constructible sheaf as H^0 and zero homology in all other degrees. Zero module sheaves are constructible. Its support is therefore contained in {0} = [0,0] at every positive level, establishing both conclusions directly from the intrinsic definitions.

theorem etaleIntegralLine_reductions
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))))
    (_hH : ∃ 𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1}
        (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))) (𝒰.f i)).obj H ≅
        (constantSheaf (𝒰.X i).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1}
          (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))).obj
            (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))))) :
    let M : scalarReductionSource l E X :=
      SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsOfUniverses
        (R₁ := (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))))
        (R₂ := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X)
        ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).preimage
            (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E X))
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (constantModuleHomRingIso (ProEt.topology X)
            (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))).inv).obj
          ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
            (toSheafify (ProEt.topology X)
              ((Functor.const X.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
                (RingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))))).obj
            ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientModulePresheaf X.ProEt
              (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))).obj
              ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar _ X).obj H).obj)))
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E (n + 1)
          (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)) X
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E X n).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) ∧
        proEtaleCohomologicalSupport
          (Y := X) (A := Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E X n).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) ⊆ Set.Icc 0 0
